task.title: Fetching an image by tag or digest
task.shortdesc: To fetch an image from Red Hat Quay, you can pull by tag or by digest. Digests provide an immutable reference to a specific image manifest.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Tags page of a repository.
Under Manifest, click the Fetch Tag icon.
When the popup box appears, users are presented with the following options:

ul.li:
Docker Pull (by digest)
Selecting any one of the four options returns a command for the respective client that allows users to pull the image.
